# Appropriation Ordinance No. 01, Series of 2000

**Appropriation Ordinance No. 01**

## Summary

An appropriation ordinance enacting the Pre-Closing Special Budget of the [[Municipality of Pitogo]] for the fiscal year ending December 31, 1999. At the close of business on December 31, 1999, there was a savings of P 3,705,190.97 and an overdraft in appropriation in the amount of P 234,976.30. The ordinance appropriates funds to cover the overdraft and make expenditures proper and legal.

**Total savings at close of business (Dec 31, 1999):** P 3,705,190.97
**Total overdraft in appropriation:** P 234,976.30

## Key Provisions

- **Section 1.** At the close of business on December 31, 1999, there is a savings of P 3,705,190.97 and an overdraft in appropriation in the amount of P 234,976.30.
- **Section 2.** The amount of P 234,976.30 is hereby appropriated to cover up overdraft in appropriation in the amount of P 234,976.30 to make it proper and legal the expenditures for the year 1999.
- **Section 3.** The Pre-Closing Special Budget prepared by the Municipal Budget Officer is hereby attached and made as integral part of this ordinance marked as "Annex A".
